name: KMC Speciality Hospitals (India) Limited
summary: KMC Speciality Hospitals (India) Limited provides medical and healthcare services in India. The company offers healthcare services in the areas of anesthesiology, arthroscopy, breast clinic, cardiology, critical care, dermatology, dental maxillofacial, diabetology, emergency and urgent care, endocrinology, family clinic, fertility centre, general surgery, general medicine, geriatrics, gastroenterology, heart and lung transplant, interventional radiology, infectious diseases, laboratory services, lung centre, liver disease, neurology, and neurosurgery; and nephrology and urology science, as well as ENT, head, and neck surgery; and kidney, liver, and bone marrow transplant.
